commitThreshold: bounded dwell that reroutes an unobserved opening
memoryRule: a local attention offer marks one watched threshold, but the least-observed threshold opens as a non-local cut in the same body
interactionRule: pointer dwell commits attention topology; flicker and over-held offers refuse; Enter, Space, and the attention control use deterministic dwells; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: horizontal score of marks -> one closed SVG body whose connectivity changes through an opening
encounterRupture: two-tap interval -> pointer dwell near a threshold with a remote unobserved consequence
temporalRupture: delayed beat ledger -> bounded topology ledger whose accumulated cuts persist in one body
mediumRupture: token score -> even-odd SVG path topology with integrated apertures and channels
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
